extraction.notes: ESS reports FFO and Core FFO only; no AFFO metric, so affo fields are null. Share count printed as 66,462,974 and converted to thousands (66,462.974) for the dollar totals; it reproduces $3.32 FFO and $4.08 Core FFO per share. Shares assume conversion of OP units and exclude DownREIT units. Core FFO line 'General and administrative and other, net' (56,785) includes the RealPage settlement ($36.5M) and another litigation matter ($19.3M) per footnote (1), plus political advocacy costs; categorized as 'other' because the printed line combines several items. Loss on early retirement of debt is printed as '-' for the current quarter and recorded as 0. Starting line and all adjustments are from the seq 11 table; the same figures also appear on seq 16 (printed S-3). Recorded page_printed is blank because the seq 11 marker has no printed number.
